HomePage.title: Own a share of a working Almaty taxi
HomePage.subtitle: Buy shares in a specific car. Its net income is deposited on Solana and split among shareholders by the program, and anyone can check every deposit and payout.

Metadata.title: AXEL — Shares in working taxis, paid out on Solana
Metadata.description: Buy shares in taxis working in Almaty, Kazakhstan. Each car is its own token on Solana, its net income is split among shareholders by the program, and every deposit and payout is public.
Metadata.ogTitle: AXEL — Own a share of a working Almaty taxi

HowItWorks.title: From a verified wallet to a payout
HowItWorks.lead: Four steps, and each one leaves a record on Solana.
HowItWorks.verifyBody: Pass a one-time identity check (KYC). Your wallet then gets a KYC record on Solana, which the program checks on every purchase and transfer.
HowItWorks.buyBody: Choose a car in its raise and buy whole shares at its listed price. Your payment waits in escrow until the car is bought and comes back in full if the raise fails.
HowItWorks.earnBody: The car works as a taxi in Almaty. Each period the operator deposits its net income into the car's vault on Solana, and the fleet's reporting system co-signs the deposit.
HowItWorks.claimBody: Your part of each deposit is your shares divided by all shares at that moment. It adds up in your portfolio; claim it whenever you like, for all your cars in one go.
HowItWorks.photoAlt: A taxi on an Almaty street at golden hour, with the mountains behind it
HowItWorks.photoCaption: A taxi in Almaty. Photo: Alina Makhatyrova, Unsplash.

Verify.title: Rules in code, records in public
Verify.lead: You don't have to take our word for the numbers. The program enforces these rules, and every account listed here opens in Solana Explorer.
Verify.tokenBody: Each car is its own Token-2022 mint, with the make, model and year written into the token's metadata.
Verify.holdersBody: Only wallets that passed KYC can buy shares or receive them in a transfer. The token checks this on every transfer, whichever app sends it.
Verify.payoutsBody: Income sits in a vault only the program can pay out from. It tracks revenue per share, so a claim pays exactly what your shares earned, and never twice.
Verify.codeBody: The programs, the backend and this app are public under the MIT license.
Verify.ledgerLead: Addresses read from the chain when this page loaded.
Verify.ledgerError: Couldn't read the car accounts from Solana. Try again from the stats above.

Disclosure.devnetBody: AXEL runs on Solana devnet, a test network. The cars listed here are test projects, prices are in test tokens with no market value, and nothing on this site is an offer to invest.
Disclosure.risksTitle: What can go wrong with a real car
Disclosure.riskIncome: Income depends on the car. It falls when the car is off the road for repairs, after an accident or when demand drops.
Disclosure.riskReport: Payouts are not guaranteed. The operator reports and deposits the income and the fleet's reporting system co-signs it, but no one outside the fleet audits the amount yet.
Disclosure.riskExit: There is no market for shares yet, so you may not be able to sell early.
Disclosure.riskValue: A car loses value as it ages.

VerifyData.title: Check the car's data yourself
VerifyData.lead: Solana keeps only fingerprints of this car's records: a hash chain of its daily trip data, the hash of each income report and of the purchase papers. Your browser downloads the published files and recomputes every fingerprint.
VerifyData.how: Each day's record is hashed as canonical JSON (RFC 8785) with SHA-256, then chained: head = SHA-256(previous head, date, record hash), starting from zeros. The program applies the same step every time the oracle records a day.
VerifyData.reading: Reading the car's accounts on Solana…
VerifyData.noSource: This deployment has no published data source, so there is nothing to check against yet.
VerifyData.notPublished: Nothing is published for this car at {url}.
VerifyData.noWebCrypto: This browser can't compute SHA-256 on this page: WebCrypto needs HTTPS.
VerifyData.failed: Couldn't download or read the published files. Try again.
VerifyData.matchBody: Your browser rebuilt the chain from {days} published days and got exactly the head Solana holds.
VerifyData.aheadNote: {days} newer published days aren't recorded on-chain yet.
VerifyData.behindBody: Solana has recorded {recorded} days, but only {published} are published. Those are consistent; the rest can't be checked until they're published.
VerifyData.problem_dateOrder: The record for {date} comes after a later day. The program never records days out of order.
VerifyData.problem_recordHash: The record for {date} doesn't hash to the value published with it: it was changed after publishing.
VerifyData.problem_statedHead: The chain step published for {date} isn't the one the records give.
VerifyData.headMismatch: The published records rebuild a different head from the one on Solana, so they aren't the records the oracle recorded.
VerifyData.depositsLead: Each deposit carries the hash of its income report and the trip data head at that moment.
VerifyData.snapshotMissing: Not in the published trip data
VerifyData.acquisition_match: Match the hash recorded at release
VerifyData.demoOrigin: These records are fictional demo data generated by scripts/seed-devnet.

Solvency.title: Every token where the program says it is
Solvency.lead: Live from Solana {network}. For each car your browser compares the vault balances with what the program owes, and the share supply with its ledger, then checks again every {seconds} seconds.

Solvency.allPassBody: The vaults hold at least what the program owes, and every share on-chain is in the ledger.
Solvency.someFailBody: A failing check was read twice to rule out a transaction landing mid-read. The failing cars are listed first.
Solvency.totalOwedHint: What every claim would pay right now
Solvency.totalEscrowHint: Money waiting for a car purchase or a refund
Solvency.ruleIncomeBody: The income vault holds at least the income deposited minus the claims paid, and that is at least what the holders are owed right now.
Solvency.ruleEscrowBody: Until the car is bought, the escrow holds at least shares sold minus refunded, times the price.
Solvency.ruleSupplyTitle: Every share is in the ledger
Solvency.ruleSupplyBody: The share token's supply equals shares sold minus refunded minus retired, and the sum of every holder's position.
Solvency.ruleCheckpointsBody: No position has counted more revenue per share than the car has earned.
Solvency.notInBrowser: One more rule, that every holder's share account equals its position, needs every token account of every car and is checked by the seed's verify-invariants script rather than in the browser.

DemoAccess.title: Try the whole cycle in two minutes
DemoAccess.lead: Seven steps with test money on Solana {network}. Each one is a real transaction of the AXEL program that you can open in Explorer.
DemoAccess.connectBody: Any Solana wallet works, switched to {network}. The demo gives it everything else: a KYC record, test tenge and a little SOL for fees.
DemoAccess.connectPointsTitle: What the demo gives your wallet
DemoAccess.connectPoint1: A 29-day demo KYC record, which only demo cars accept
DemoAccess.connectPoint2: Test tenge (tKZT) and a little SOL for fees
DemoAccess.connectPoint3: Shares of a car that is already on the road, and its payouts
DemoAccess.statusErrorBody: This site's demo routes didn't answer. Check your connection and try again.
DemoAccess.unavailableTitle: The demo can't hand out access right now
DemoAccess.accessBody: Sign a message, not a transaction. The demo key then writes a 29-day demo KYC record for this wallet, and the faucet sends {amount} and 0.01 SOL for fees.
DemoAccess.signInAgainHint: Steps 3 and 4 need a fresh signature on this device. Signing again sends nothing new.
DemoAccess.turnstileFailed: The bot check didn't load. Reload the page and try again.
DemoAccess.buyTitle: Buy shares in an open raise
DemoAccess.buyBody: Your tKZT goes into the car's escrow account on Solana, not to anyone's wallet. If the raise misses its goal, the program gives every tenge back.
DemoAccess.buyDoneBody: This wallet has paid into a raise. The money stays in escrow until the raise closes.
DemoAccess.noRaise: No raise that takes demo investors is open right now. Go on with step 3.
DemoAccess.sharesTitle: Receive shares of a car on the road
DemoAccess.sharesBody: The desk sends you {count} shares of {car}. The transfer goes through the share token's transfer hook, which checks both wallets' KYC and settles their income first.
DemoAccess.simulateBody: The car's operator deposits a month of rental income, and the car's oracle co-signs the report. The platform fee goes to the treasury; the rest is split among holders at once, by shares.
DemoAccess.cooldown: The next month can be simulated in {seconds} s.
DemoAccess.claimBody: The program pays your part into your own tKZT account; no one else can receive it.
DemoAccess.claimDoneBody: You have claimed {amount} from this car.
DemoAccess.verifyBody: Your browser downloads the car's published trip data and income reports and recomputes every hash Solana holds. Simulated months are labelled as such.
DemoAccess.solvencyBody: Every car's income vault and escrow, checked live against what the program owes holders.
DemoAccess.fineprint: Everything here runs on Solana {network} with test tokens that have no market value. The demo's keys can only write demo KYC records, mint test tenge, move the desk's demo shares and deposit into the demo car.
